More photo types, and bulk updates for people already in a client.

### What's changed
- **iPhone photos and more.** ID photos, template backgrounds and logos can now be JPG, PNG, HEIC (iPhone photos), WebP, TIFF, AVIF, BMP or GIF. HEIC and TIFF are converted by the program, so nothing needs saving as JPG first.
- **Choose which photo types to use.** When you pick a folder of photos to import, every supported type is ticked, with the number of each found beside it. Untick a type to leave those files out.
- **Bulk update.** Change many people already in a client at once: import 1,000 people now and their photos later, or update a detail for everyone. Choose a folder of photos, named after the people as for importing, and/or a CSV of changes (such as an edited **Export people** file). Blank cells leave details as they are, names are never changed, and nobody is added or deleted. People who share a name are skipped, and rows or photos that match nobody are listed.

Existing installs keep all their templates, clients and people.

### Updating
An administrator will see **Version 3.0.13 is available** at the top of the program — choose **Update now**. Or download the setup below and run it over the top.

### New install
Download **ID-Card-Printing-Software-Free-Setup-3.0.13.exe** below and run it. The setup isn't code-signed, so the first time Windows may show *Windows protected your PC*: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**, then **Yes**.
